snippet.title: Imperiums: Rome vs Carthage announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Historical 4X turn-based strategy game set in time of early Roman expansion. Choose from 25 playable factions and try different gameplay styles on a huge map with 5000 tiles.

Wishlist now https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839160/Imperiums_Rome_vs_Carthage/ and get LAUNCH DISCOUNT.

Imperiums: Rome vs Carthage DLC will test your tactical and strategic genius to the limits. Can the established empires defend the current world order, or will they be forced to make room for new rising states? Go through the fires of war, be destroyed or rise from the ashes to become the new hegemon!
